description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Community You Will Join:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p>Every day, Airbnb hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. Since our founding, more than 5 million hosts have welcomed over 1.5 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization plays a pivotal role in driving the company’s growth and expansion efforts worldwide. Our teammates work on commercializing Airbnb’s new and existing businesses, helping Airbnb expand beyond its core offering as a place to stay. This includes recruiting and developing Airbnb’s global supply of high-quality stays, and executing Airbnb’s global strategy in the market. With a focus on business strategy, quality supply and international expansion, the team is leading the way for Airbnb’s continued growth and success in its next chapter.&nbsp;</p> <p>The Global Markets Team, which sits within CBO, ensures that Airbnb is locally relevant and serves the needs of our global hosts and guests, helping regions more efficiently plan and execute growth strategies across supply, demand, and other surfaces in a way that will resonate with our communities.&nbsp;</p> <p>As we expand our business, we look for the best and brightest to drive strategic business decisions. To this end, the team is looking for a Business Operations and Growth Lead to join our Australia and New Zealand team (ANZ).&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>You will work closely with the cross-functional leaders and teams, and play a key role in scaling our community growth and optimization-focused programs. The successful candidate will report to the Country Manager, ANZ.&nbsp;This role is based in Sydney and will require in-person office attendance, with flexibility on the days and frequency.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></span></p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Align all functions&nbsp; to achieve Australia and New Zealand’s business objectives in partnership with the Country Manager.</li> <li>Drive regular business operation meetings and initiate meaningful conversations - leading weekly meetings with cross-functional project teams to ensure key initiatives are on track in the country.&nbsp;</li> <li>Use all available data sources and tools, internal and external, to analyze macro and micro trends, and present analysis, insights, and actionable plans to Airbnb country and regional leadership team to drive key business decisions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own the day-to-day business analysis.&nbsp; Anticipate changes before they happen and align adjustments to&nbsp; maximize growth and minimize risk.</li> <li>Own the conception, execution, and measurement of cross-functional initiatives end-to-end. Concretely, this means defining a crisp problem statement, articulating the ideal solution to that problem, identifying key dependencies blocking that solution, and then working with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve the solution. These initiatives will span across the demand, supply, and regulatory surfaces of the business.&nbsp;</li> <li>Assist the country Manager in owning the performance narrative for key metrics and deliver the story to senior leaders in a concise and clear manner in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Minimum of 10+ years of work experience, preferably with combined exposure to business growth, business analytics, and project management in a dynamic entrepreneurial environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>A proven bias to action and ability to own a project from conception through to post-mortem.</li> <li>Ability to work in a world of uncertainty and ambiguity - to create clarity from abstraction.</li> <li>A familiarity with AI tools would be considered an asset.&nbsp;</li> <li>A world class written and verbal communicator with the ability to present at all levels of an organization in a succinct, clear and eloquent manner.&nbsp;</li> <li>A proven track record of being able to storytell, influence and rally diverse cross-functional stakeholders against a common mission or goal using both qualitative and quantitative insights.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to not only dive into details to drive execution but also zoom out to contextualize specific recommendations/initiatives within the broader company strategy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to multi-task by prioritizing work and coordinating required support across various functions to achieve project goals and objectives.&nbsp;</li> <li>Impeccable organizational skills, attention to detail and ability to document processes &amp; decisions made.</li> <li>Experience implementing and scaling initiatives across globally dispersed teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with multiple departments.</li> <li>Hands-on approach, getting things done fast.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfort with manipulating large datasets in excel is a must. SQL proficiency strongly preferred.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p>

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>Every day, millions of Airbnb hosts around the world create comfortable, reliable and welcoming stays and Experiences for our guests. Hosting on Airbnb offers a unique way to meet our Hosts’ financial goals but the rewards for opening their home or sharing a passion go beyond their bank account. Hosting also offers the opportunity to impact their local community, share their culture and connect with people they wouldn’t have met otherwise.<br><br>We know that our global community of hosts is one of Airbnb’s most precious assets and we are very intentional on how we nurture the common identity of being an Airbnb Host. The Airbnb Community team is looking for an experienced Community Engagement Lead to work in the territory and deliver upon our Community Growth, Engagement and business goals.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You will Make:</strong></p> <p>The Airbnb team is looking for a Community Engagement Lead to build and lead our Host Community strategy in Spain and Portugal. You will regionally implement and iterate on Community programs that engage Hosts at scale, such as the Host Clubs program and Host events, while also innovating and testing new methods that can influence and strengthen the global community strategy.</p> <p>In this role, Community custodians in each region are responsible for balancing the needs of our Hosting Community with those of Airbnb. You will work closely with and report to the Community Regional Lead and build collaborative relationships with the relevant Country Manager, Policy, Legal, Marketing and Communications Leads, supply teams and central Community team to support our hosts.&nbsp;</p> <p>The ideal candidate has extensive Community experience and knowledge, especially in developing Community strategies as well as building and maintaining programs that connect and engage at scale.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Overall:</p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary bridge between the local Airbnb team and the Host Community, coordinating and prioritizing cross functional activities that entail community action across the territory</li> <li>Lead Community growth, engagement and impact projects and initiatives from planning to delivery. This includes developing project plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams, coordinating multiple stakeholders, identifying project risks and crafting mitigation plans.</li> <li>Develop and execute local Community Programs with clear communication, efficient resource usage, and a deep focus on overall project execution.</li> <li>Collaborate across functions to drive meaningful impact within Airbnb and its Host Community, working closely with Country Manager, the policy, legal, communications, marketing, partnerships, and supply teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>Coordinate the activities and daily operations of one Community Engagement Manager.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Community Growth:</p> <ul> <li>Develop and test new value propositions and methods for growing our host communities across Spain and Portugal.</li> <li>Identify new approaches to recruit, onboard and manage new community leaders&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Community Engagement:</p> <ul> <li>Design effective initiatives for our train the trainer model, and content strategies to drive Host engagement in Community programs and foster conversation</li> <li>Support global Community Engagement Programming and evolve for local language and needs</li> <li>Lead and organise effective Community events, both online and in-person</li> </ul> <p>Community Impact:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Identify country needs and develop&nbsp; in-market projects to drive Host success and accelerate business goals.</li> <li>Develop resources, engaging and high impact communications, and training materials for cross functional business partners.</li> <li>Work with relevant regional stakeholders to help them leverage and collaborate with the Host Community and help them identify and test new opportunities to do so.&nbsp;</li> <li>Influence regional prioritization, process improvement, and program feedback.</li> <li>Develop deep knowledge of your assigned geographic markets and become the go-to source for all Host Community information relating to local needs, trends and market dynamics for internal and external partners.</li> <li>Co-develop strategies in partnership with Supply teams to optimize host performance across quality, pricing, and availability, empowering hosts with the tools and insights needed to set them up for long-term success.</li> <li>Leverage familiarity with STR regulatory environments to drive host engagement and education on compliance initiatives and regulatory obligations collaborating closely with Policy and Legal teams to ensure hosts are informed and well-supported.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in Community Management, Strategy, Innovation, Operations, Project Management&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong strategic project Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join:</strong></p> <p>The Community Support org handles tens of millions of interactions yearly, engaging with Airbnb customers by phone, messaging, chat, or social media channels. The group handles hundreds of issues across categories including Cancellations, Account Issues, Refunds, Payments, Reservations, Extenuating Circumstances, Booking &amp; Listing issues, Safety &amp; Claims. The organization is globally distributed with offices in San Francisco, Dublin, Montreal, Seattle, Singapore, Manila, Gurgaon and an extensive partner network serving all regions.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a seasoned Forecasting and Demand Planning Analyst on our Community Support (CS) team. This individual is responsible for demand forecasting and long-term planning across multi-channel contact center operations for our Global Operations team. This role ensures the organization has the right resources, at the right time, with the right skills to meet service level objectives while optimizing cost and productivity.</p> <p>The role combines planning, advanced analytics and business partnership to drive scalable, data-driven workforce decisions in a complex, fast-changing environment.</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Demand Forecasting &amp; Statistical Modeling</p> <ul> <li>Own short-term, mid-term, and long-term demand forecasting across all Global Operations teams and channels (phone, messaging, email, back-office etc.).</li> <li>Design, develop, and maintain statistically robust demand forecasting models using time series and machine learning techniques (e.g., exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression-based models etc.).</li> <li>Perform trend, seasonality, and variance decomposition; detect structural breaks, outliers, and demand anomalies.</li> <li>Quantify forecast uncertainty through confidence intervals, error distributions, and bias analysis.</li> <li>Perform scenario modeling for peak demand periods, product launches, growth initiatives, and unplanned demand events.</li> <li>Continuously assess model performance using statistical accuracy metrics (MAPE, RMSE, MAE, bias etc).</li> <li>Establish model governance standards, including documentation, validation, back-testing, and post-mortem analysis.</li> <li>Research, prototype, and implement new forecasting and optimization techniques as business needs evolve.</li> <li>Perform scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to quantify trade-offs between service levels, cost, and utilization.</li> </ul> <p>Advanced Analytics</p> <ul> <li>In partnership with the Analytics and Data Engineering team, design and build scalable planning data pipelines, dashboards, and automate forecasting and capacity models to improve scalability, repeatability, and timeliness.</li> <li>Use SQL and Python to extract, transform, and analyze large-scale operational datasets to monitor forecast accuracy, capacity gaps, utilization, and operational risk.</li> </ul> <p>Decision Support &amp; Stakeholder Communication</p> <ul> <li>Present forecast assumptions, methodologies, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations in clear, executive-ready formats and act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and participate in demand/capacity planning discussions in cross-functional forums.</li> <li>Align cross-functional stakeholders (Delivery, Product, Finance, HR, and others) to embed planning outputs into execution and operational decision-making.</li> <li>Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and best practices in the demand and capacity planning area to optimize cost while maintaining or improving customer experience and service-level outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in demand forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or applied analytics.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Economics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>Strong foundation in probability, statistics, and optimization.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and validating forecasting models (time series analysis, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, regression, hypothesis testing) and capacity models (Erlang, queueing theory, service-level and utilization modeling).</li> <li>Strong understanding of contact center metrics (AHT, ASA, service level, shrinkage, occupancy); experience supporting large-scale, multi-site, or global contact center environments preferred.</li> <li>Advanced analytical skills with strong proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python and data visualization tools such as Tableau.</li> <li>Experience with WFM tools (e.g., NICE, Verint, Aspect) or planning platforms (e.g., Anaplan) preferred.</li> <li>Strong business acumen with the ability to balance cost efficiency and customer experience outcomes.</li> <li>Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder influence skills; ability to explain complex analytical concepts to non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, and highly dynamic environments.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000; Proven experience working with many engineering teams and cross functional partners.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong expertise in building large-scale backend systems and experience in user facing features.</li> <li>Strong product and design instinct, previous proven experience building delightfully designed experiences.</li> <li>Flexible in leadership style, can adapt to a variety of ways of working depending on the situation.</li> <li>Experience leading and shipping large initiatives with high business impact.</li> <li>Creating a strong culture of operational excellence with focus on raising the bar for quality, reliability and availability.</li> <li>Good judgment in making tradeoffs to balance short-term business needs with long-term technical quality.</li> <li>Strong communication skill and ability to influence decisions from a wide variety of stakeholders.</li> <li>Experience fostering an inclusive and engaging team environment.</li> <li>Able to identify, retain, grow and acquire critical talent.</li> <li>Strong commitment to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion within teams.</li> <li><strong>Fluency in communication in English and Mandarin.&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your Location:</strong></p> <p>This position is working remotely within China Mainland. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</p> <p><br><br></p>

Every day, Hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</p> <p>The Analytics Centre of Excellence (ACOE) at Airbnb, based in India, is a hub of knowledge and expertise that aims to provide data-driven decision-making, enabling Airbnb's business goals. The ACOE's vision is to build a world-class analytics organization that provides scalable, AI-enabled analytics. We work with various business functions such as payments, trust, digital, customer support, hosting, sales, social, compliance, risk, platforms and partnerships &amp; economics.</p> <p>The ACOE's delivery framework is designed to provide relevant and contextual insights for data-driven decisions. This includes a one-stop solution for metrics, dashboards driving actionable insights, optimization of performance, measuring pre/post feature impact, sizing the ROI of opportunities, prioritization of opportunities, anomaly-driven alerting mechanisms, root cause analysis of metric deviation, and exploratory hypothesis testing.</p> <p><strong>The Community You Will Join:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Lead Advanced Analyst in our India Analytics team who works with the Community Support business. The analyst must have deep functional expertise in building and scaling analytical solutions and serve as a strategic thought partner to product teams and business leaders across marketplace teams driving insights, recommendations, and data-informed decisions at scale. This role will sit under the Advanced Analytics family and support Business leaders within our Strategic Planning &amp; Operations organization.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary data thought partner to product and business leaders across Community Support, providing strategic insights, recommendations, and enabling data-informed decisions at an organizational level.</li> <li>Drive day-to-day product analytics and create scalable, reusable data tools and frameworks that elevate the entire team's analytical capability.</li> <li>Build and scale advanced analytical capabilities; leverage Airbnb's state-of-the-art machine learning infrastructure and central data science tools to collaborate with engineers, product managers, designers, and operations agents to achieve shared, cross-functional goals.</li> <li>Champion AI-first analytics practices across the team identifying high-impact opportunities to integrate LLM-based tools, AutoML, and advanced AI capabilities into analytical workflows.</li> <li>Demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and commitment to Airbnb's mission of belonging.</li> <li>Develop a deep understanding of how guests and hosts interact with our Community Support platform and how we can manage risk while meeting regulatory compliance requirements through structured and unstructured data sources.</li> <li>Mentor and guide junior analysts, fostering a culture of analytical rigor, curiosity, and continuous skill development.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive the product analytics roadmap, prioritization, and delivery of solutions in the Strategic Planning &amp; Operations space, operating with minimal direction and planning up to 6 months ahead.</li> <li>Lead projects end-to-end: building timelines, defining key milestones, providing regular updates to product managers and analytics leadership, and delivering against agreed timelines.</li> <li>Work closely with Product Managers and Business leads to design, execute, and evaluate A/B tests; proactively identify and communicate common pitfalls and caveats of experimentation.</li> <li>Build credibility and trust with the team by building high-quality ground truth datasets and dashboards that empower stakeholders to answer data questions quickly and independently.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Engineering to spec out logging and with Analytics Engineering to build scalable data tools for mass consumption within Airbnb.</li> <li>Devise business metric frameworks and optimization models to support Airbnb's product, operations, and policy decisions at scale.</li> <li>Influence data-driven decisions across global sites and business verticals via business reviews, self-serve portals, planning scorecards, and impact analyses.</li> <li>Experiment with new Airbnb policy/product features to help deter and mitigate risk; translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership.</li> <li>Lead and influence machine learning model development in partnership with DS/Engineering teams to automate policy enforcement decisions, while routing the most complex cases for manual review.</li> <li>Proactively identify opportunities to apply AI-assisted tools (e.g., LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to accelerate analytical delivery and unlock new analytical capabilities.</li> <li>Ensure the availability of data quality and integrity for analysis and reporting by blending external and internal data sources, working closely with global operations and India analytics functions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of industry experience with an advanced degree (Master's or PhD is a plus) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Operations Research).</li> <li>&nbsp;Expert-level SQL; complex query optimization, performance tuning, and schema design; strong understanding of ETL/ELT pipelines; working knowledge of data transformation tools.</li> <li>Programming &amp; Statistical Modeling: Advanced proficiency in Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, statsmodels); ability to build and deploy end-to-end analytical models; experience with advanced regression techniques, time-series analysis, and causal inference.</li> <li>Experimentation &amp; Analytical Frameworks: Expert-level A/B testing and multivariate testing; advanced experiment design including power analysis, switchback testing, and quasi-experimental methods (diff-in-diff, regression discontinuity); digital funnel and cohort analysis.</li> <li>Machine Learning &amp; AI (Proficient): Proficiency in ML techniques including EDA, hypothesis testing, linear/logistic regression, SVM, ridge/lasso regression, random forest, NLP, KNN, and K-means; hands-on experience with LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) and applied prompt engineering; ability to independently deploy AI tools to solve analytical problems; awareness of responsible AI, data privacy (GDPR/CCPA), and bias mitigation.</li> <li>Experience with forecasting and advanced econometric modeling is a requirement.</li> <li>Visualization &amp; Storytelling: Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent BI platforms; ability to design and build executive-level dashboards and self-serve analytics portals; strong data storytelling and presentation skills for senior leadership audiences.</li> <li>Data Foundations: Strong working knowledge of Presto, Hive, Teradata, and Spark; experience designing scalable data models for analytical consumption.</li> <li>AI tool proficiency: Independently applies AI tools (LLMs, AutoML, NLP pipelines) to solve complex business problems.</li> <li>Designs and implements AI-enhanced analytical workflows that can be adopted team-wide.</li> <li>Evaluates and selects appropriate AI models for specific use cases; understands trade-offs between model complexity, interpretability, and performance.</li> <li>Champions responsible AI principles including bias detection, model fairness, and compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA).</li> <li>Contributes to AI-first culture by sharing best practices, running enablement sessions, and identifying new AI use cases.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders in a cross-cultural environment without direct authority.</li> <li>Exceptional communication skills;&nbsp; able to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven track record of delivering full-stack data projects from inception to measurable business impact.</li> <li>Strong mentoring and coaching skills; demonstrated ability to develop junior talent.</li> <li>Positive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to maintain confidentiality and objectivity.</li> <li>Exceptional problem-solving abilities, self-motivation, and autonomy; strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams and meet deadlines.</li> <li>Proficiency in agile project management practices and tools (e.g., Jira/Asana).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging</strong>:</p> <p>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>Please note, this role is based in Gurugram, India and relocation is not offered at this time.&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p>Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">India Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>₹3,080,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>₹4,400,000 INR</span></div></div></div>

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced professional to join our team as the Payments Insights Analytics Lead. In this role, you will play a critical part in executing the strategic direction of Airbnb's Payments operations.</p> <p>Within this role, you will enable, facilitate, and assist in streamlining integrated data-driven decision making across the Payments Platform, Product, Operations organizations. The team is committed to operational excellence and Host and Guest experience through a culture of problem-solving, guided by data and research. We inject quantitative measurements into our user journey, product, processes and implement objective indicators of success. You will collaborate in the development and implementation of policies and procedures related to receiving and processing funds. The ideal candidate is hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service through coaching and upleveling their team. This is a full time position based in Canada.</p> <p>The Manager supports one or more internal CS services. The Manager is an operational leadership role that requires substantial experience in customer service and team management. Managers oversee teams of approximately 10-15 ambassadors and should have the ability to guide and uplevel their ambassadors, demonstrating top-level customer service skills. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance real-time and planned work are also required. They should also be adaptable and responsive in our fast paced environment, sometimes under pressure, while remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, efficient and demonstrating a high level of professionalism and confidentiality.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Oversee a strong operational environment for your teams and ensure high quality support for the community from your team</strong></span></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Manage the team execution of complex, sensitive, and/or urgent issues that might pose a significant risk to our brand or community, including acting as the highest escalation point for case consults and high level escalations from other stakeholders</li> <li>Meet with your direct reports regularly to review their work and provide high quality, behavior-based coaching; must be able to create a performance development strategy/plan for your service(s).</li> <li>Provide best practices guidelines to your team on how to handle cases and situations, and ensure that ways of working are documented and followed.</li> <li>Ensure that the team is consistently staffed appropriately and that staff complete onboarding and ongoing training.</li> <li>For cases that involve internal stakeholders, guide ambassadors to take proper action to case closure and in rare cases, support with in-the-weeds case handling</li> <li>Collaborate with Capacity Planning &amp; WFP on setting minimum headcount, ensuring adequate coverage, contingency planning impacts of changes, and advocating for staffing needs vs. volume/work</li> </ul> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Drive performance at the ambassador, team, and service level</strong></span></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Ensure individual team members are held accountable to performance goals in a fair and equitable manner by setting clear expectations, following-up individually, and coaching team members positively to develop and improve their skills in a tailored way</li> <li>Manage both ambassador&nbsp; and team performance, including identifying trends in performance, providing corrective actions and positive overall feedback, and writing year end reviews and improvement plans</li> <li>Ability to set and articulate the vision and focus for the quarter; deliver that vision and focus through all hands-type meetings</li> <li>Share input and recommendations about service target setting.</li> <li>Provide oversight on the overall service performance and contribute to reporting on trends and providing a holistic picture of the service to the Delivery Director</li> </ul> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Build and nurture an engaged and diverse team</strong></span></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Own and manage end-to-end people strategy and operations within your ambassador team to foster a high performing and sustainable team environment. This includes hiring, driving onboarding, talent development, and people engagement/wellness/morale</li> <li>Enable team and individual professional success through supporting and challenging your team to meet and exceed expectations with clear goals/expectations, feedback, one-on-ones, and coaching</li> <li>Support team in professional development within a team by finding and creating development opportunities and leveraging company-wide resources to regularly drive development within your team.</li> <li>Keep up with day-to-day management duties such as time off approvals, team and one-on-one meetings, and managing Talent-related issues</li> <li>Maintain a culture of openness, transparency and accountability allowing our teams to deliver their best work while being themselves&nbsp;</li> <li>Demonstrate strong leadership on important issues including Diversity &amp; Belonging, Allyship, Ethics, Compliance and maintaining high standards of service to the company</li> </ul> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Support strategic initiatives within Delivery and your service as needed</strong></span></p> <ul> <ul> <li>Lead the team toward the successful execution of company or other strategic changes or goals within your service by cascading updates and changes, communicating new requirements, and providing feedback</li> <li>Support, as needed, internal Delivery performance &amp; operations improvement projects, in collaboration with the Delivery Excellence team and cross-functional partners</li> <li>Think critically and constantly evaluate our procedures. Collect feedback from the team to identify opportunities to improve performance and better optimize processes for the team, service, and global community</li> </ul> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of progressive experience in a customer service or an operations role, with 5 years in a role directly managing staff &amp; the employee lifecycle</li> <li>Demonstrable experience in driving improved performance of teams as a line manager</li> <li>Experience in the deployment of resources to manage real-time crisis situations, including managing high severity/sensitivity cases and decision-making authority for losses</li> <li>Experience in data analysis and reporting to identify performance trends, as well as&nbsp; developing and implementing performance management standards</li> <li>Experience translating big picture goals and strategy into implementable and concrete actions for your teams, including setting operational or functional targets or performance goals&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to work weekend days, holidays, and on-call required</li> <li>Strong communicator, with fluency, in both written and spoken, English</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Your skills and competencies:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Exceptional leadership and team management skills to manage a team of professionals - comfort with conflict, giving and receiving feedback, and handling employee/Talent issues</li> <li>Strong communication skills to collaborate with different stakeholders and manage sensitive cases, while remaining calm and poised under pressure</li> <li>Organized and resourceful; able to juggle and multi-task, with an attention to detail and follow through even in ambiguous situations</li> <li>In-depth understanding of customer service operations and processes; able to translate that to your team</li> <li>Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities to evaluate procedures and identify opportunities for improvement</li> <li>Ability to cascade with context and lead your team through changes</li> <li>Exceptional coaching skills, you have high EQ and know how to tailor your feedback &amp; communication style to meet the needs of your coachee or mentee</li> <li>Cultural competency and a strong commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion within the team</li> <li>Proficiency in various data analysis and reporting tools to track performance trends (tableau, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, etc.)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Location: </strong></p> <p>This position is Remote Eligible - Canada. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a province where Airbnb Canada, Inc. has a registered entity. Currently we can hire in the following provinces: Alberta, Ontario, British Columbia, Quebec, and Saskatchewan. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with your recruiter on what provinces you are eligible to work from.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging: </strong></p> <p>Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</p> <p>We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.</p> <p>We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.</p> <hr> <p><em>We use automated tools to help our recruiting team efficiently screen a large volume of applications. All final hiring decisions are made by a human reviewer.</em>&nbsp;</p> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">This role is newly created and does not replace or backfill an existing position.&nbsp;</span></em></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">Canada Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$94,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$117,000 CAD</span></div></div></div>

We are creating highly local, personal and authentic experiences for our host and guest community around the world. Our platform connects millions of people a year and furthers our mission to create a world where anyone can belong anywhere.</p> <p>To power the global Airbnb community, we are building a world-class payments platform - one that currently supports 191 countries, 63 currencies, connects dozens of payment providers and banks, and processes billions of dollars per year for all of Airbnb’s business units. As the platform grows, we’ll be adding new payment partners, establishing licensed payments companies around the world, and building innovative payment experiences and financial products for our guests and hosts. Our goal? To create a future where transparent, simple, and familiar payment solutions can empower people, entrepreneurs and communities on our global marketplace.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>The Difference You Will Make:</strong></span></p> <p>Airbnb is seeking an experienced and strategic Payment Partnerships Manager to drive the vision, execution, and ongoing performance of our partner network supporting how we pay out to our global host community across 200+ markets. Reporting to the Head of Payment Partnerships, this role is pivotal in managing the partnerships that ensure our hosts are paid reliably, efficiently, compliantly and in alignment with our growth and platform goals.</p> <p>You will lead business development, deal negotiation, and strategic relationship management for a portfolio of high-value payment partners. With a focus on impact and long-term alignment, you'll help craft our partner landscape, structure and renegotiate commercial agreements, and serve as a critical voice in expanding and optimizing how payments to hosts are enabled around the world.</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>A Typical Day:&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p>Strategic Partner Leadership</p> <ul> <li>Define and evolve our payout partner strategy in collaboration with the broader Payments, Product, Compliance and Finance teams to ensure coverage, performance, and alignment with Airbnb’s strategic and financial goals.</li> <li>Identify the right partners in each market, structure new deals, and renegotiate existing relationships to optimize for cost, reliability, reach, and innovation.</li> <li>Drive global deal execution for payouts—developing commercial structures, navigating regional regulatory constraints, and shaping contracts to meet Airbnb’s evolving needs.</li> </ul> <p>Relationship Management &amp; Performance</p> <ul> <li>Own and cultivate high-impact relationships with financial institutions, payment processors, banks, and other key partners, managing executive-level engagement to ensure Airbnb is a priority client.</li> <li>Monitor partner performance rigorously, identify gaps or opportunities, and lead cross-functional efforts to address issues or evolve terms.</li> <li>Lead strategic business reviews and act as the point of escalation and problem resolution for performance or operational misalignment.</li> </ul> <p>Global Payments Strategy &amp; Influence</p> <ul> <li>Assist in the ongoing scaling of Airbnb’s payout infrastructure—ensuring that partner decisions reflect regional needs, market conditions, cost structures, and regulatory environments.</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Treasury, Risk, Product, Engineering, and Global Operations to align execution with global strategy.</li> <li>Stay ahead of industry and macroeconomic changes affecting international payments and proactively bring forward opportunities and risk mitigation strategies.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Your Expertise:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in the payments or fintech industry, with at least 8 years in strategic partnerships, business development, or enterprise account management.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in owning commercial negotiations and managing multi-million dollar partnerships that balance customer experience, innovation, and financial return.</li> <li>Proven ability to craft and execute partner strategies that result in measurable business growth and process improvement.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of global payment methods, financial products, and cross-border payout solutions.</li> <li>Understanding of payments cost structure (e.g., interchange, chargebacks, FX, treasury flow), and experience optimizing it through partner levers.</li> <li>Experience in resolving partner conflicts or escalations, ideally across multiple markets or regulatory contexts.</li> <li>International payments experience, especially in marketplace or platform models.</li> <li>Experience in platform organizations advising internal stakeholders on partner enablement strategy.</li> <li>Experience working with regulators or regulated partners in cross-border payout environments.</li> <li>MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Your Location:</strong></span><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><br></span></p> <p><span style="color: #000000; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">This position is US - Remote Eligible. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community you will join:</strong></p> <p>The Chief Business Officer (CBO) organization drives Airbnb's growth and expansion around the world — commercializing our new and existing businesses and executing our global strategy in the market. The Global Markets team sits within CBO and makes sure Airbnb is locally relevant everywhere we operate, helping regions plan and execute growth across supply, demand, and the surfaces our communities use.</p> <p>Local growth levers are one of the fastest-growing parts of that toolkit — guest incentives, host-funded promotions, engagement and CRM, country partnerships, and promotional merchandising. Over the past year we've taken these from pilots to scaled programs including incentives, host-funded promotions and promotional-merchandising. That momentum has outpaced our operating model — execution is spread across regional pods, central growth marketing, product, merchandising, and finance, with parallel roadmaps and no single source of truth. We're building a dedicated program management capability to bring it all together, and we want you at the center of it.</p> <p><strong>The difference you will make:</strong></p> <p><em>This role requires candidates to be based in San Francisco. This role is not expected to be eligible for relocation support.</em></p> <p>As the Program Operations Lead for Growth Levers, you own the operating system that turns our fast-growing portfolio of levers into coordinated, on-time execution. You bring incentives, host-funded promotions, engagement and CRM, partnerships, and merchandising onto one roadmap, one source of truth, and one operating rhythm — so that product, growth marketing, merchandising, finance, and regional and country operations always know what is shipping, who owns it, when, and what it costs.</p> <p>This is deliberately an execution and coordination role, distinct from the business and strategy roles around it. The lever business owners (regional pods and individual lever DRIs) own their outcomes; the growth-levers playbook and country-planning lead defines what each lever is and how countries should deploy it; central growth marketing, product, and merchandising build the platforms. You own the connective tissue between them — the intake, sequencing, operating cadence, budget-to-roadmap translation, launch governance, and institutional knowledge that make the whole portfolio executable at scale and keep it running when individual owners are away.</p> <p><strong>A typical day:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own one cross-lever roadmap and source of truth — consolidating incentives, host-funded promotions, engagement and CRM, partnerships, and merchandising campaigns across all regions into a single plan</li> <li>Build and run the levers operating system — the cadence, launch readiness, and clear RACI across Global Markets, central growth marketing, product, and finance, with resourcing gaps surfaced early</li> <li>Set up the change-intake and sequencing process — a consolidated intake process for new campaign and lever requests, with clear rules for prioritization, approval, and conflict resolution when campaigns overlap (for example, competing merchandising or incentive placements in the same market and week).</li> <li>Translate budget into an executable plan — track committed versus available spend across levers and markets, turn funding decisions into roadmap changes quickly, and give leadership a live view of where the money is going and what it is returning.</li> <li>Be the connective tissue across a fragmented ownership map — regional business operations, growth marketing, partnerships, and the central product and merchandising teams — driving alignment and unblocking decisions so there is one conversation, not many.</li> <li>Turn the levers playbooks and country plans into shipped campaigns — partnering with the playbook and country-planning owners to convert their strategy into standardized templates, coupon and efficiency-reference (ERF) libraries, launch checklists, and repeatable operations that scale across markets.</li> <li>Make performance legible — partner with Advanced Analytics and FP&amp;A on consistent tracking, post-mortems, and readouts that feed the learning agenda (efficiency, incrementality, seasonality, auto-apply, spotlights) and standardize what good looks like across regions.</li> <li>Own the Global Markets reporting cadence — assemble and steer the Weekly Business Review (WBR) with the RDs, drive the weekly leadership report and the monthly country-performance newsletter, coordinate the team staff meeting, and prepare executive and country-deep-dive reviews — so leadership always has one accurate, current picture of the business and the levers.</li> <li>Run the recurring cross-functional roadmap syncs that keep Global Markets aligned — with payments, advanced analytics, growth marketing, merchandising, and international product — turning roadmap changes, guardrails, and escalations into clear decisions and next steps.</li> <li>Hold the operating system together through peak seasons and leadership absences — keeping the levers and the reporting cadence moving over the summer and other periods when business owners are out, so nothing depends on any one person.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your expertise:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years in program management, business operations, or marketing/GTM operations — ideally orchestrating growth, marketing, or commercial programs across multiple markets in a marketplace, e-commerce, or consumer-tech environment.</li> <li>A proven track record establishing a new operating system or central coordination capability from scratch — intake, prioritization, RACI, cadence, and governance — and scaling it across many teams and geographies.</li> <li>Exceptional cross-functional orchestration in a heavily matrixed org — you create clarity where ownership is split across product, growth marketing, merchandising, finance, and regional and country operations, and you are a trusted partner to senior leaders up to the executive level.</li> <li>Strong operating discipline — cross-workstream roadmaps, change-intake and sequencing, conflict resolution, launch management, business reviews and executive reporting, and crisp written communication that keeps distributed teams aligned.</li> <li>Budget-to-execution fluency — comfortable translating multi-million-dollar budget decisions into roadmap and resourcing changes, and reporting spend and return to leadership.</li> <li>Analytical fluency — you partner with analytics and finance on performance, efficiency, and incrementality, set consistent measurement standards, and are comfortable in the numbers (SQL familiarity a plus).</li> <li>Thrives in ambiguity and transition — comfortable operating while ownership models are still forming, with a strong bias to action, ownership, and ruthless prioritization.</li> <li>Desirable: hands-on experience with one or more growth levers — incentives, promotions and coupons, host-funded offers, lifecycle/CRM, merchandising, or partnerships — and experience across international markets Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</p> <h2>The Community You Will Join:</h2> <p>The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI-powered tools, implementation of legal systems &amp; integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.&nbsp;</p> <h2>The Difference You Will Make:</h2> <p>We're looking for a world-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end-to-end, from design through support.</p> <p>You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.</p> <p>This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.</p> <p>If you're energized by fast-paced problem-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What You'll Do</h1> <h2>Embedded Deployment &amp; Enablement</h2> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in-house counsel to identify high-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2>Governance &amp; Stakeholder Management</h2> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>AI Enablement</h2> <ul> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).</li> <li>&nbsp; &nbsp; Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1>What We're Looking For</h1> <ul> <li>8+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.</li> <li>Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.</li> <li>Proven track record of architecting and building AI-powered applications including multi-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations</li> <li>Proven track record in forward-deployed, embedded, or client-centric technical positions.</li> <li>Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation</li> <li>Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.</li> <li>Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration in large global organizations.</li> <li>Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.</li> <li>Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy-in from stakeholders and leadership..</li> </ul>

This role is a key leadership position within the platform product organization and will report into our Global Director of Payments Platform Product management.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;
